name: download_asset
description: Download a supported public image asset (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF) into the workspace with SSRF, redirect-hop, content-type, size, and output-path validation. Use this only after the user wants a remote image saved or after fetch_url returns image candidates.

url.description: The public image URL to download (must be http:// or https://).

output_dir.description: Optional output directory. Relative paths are placed under the default downloaded-assets directory; absolute paths must stay inside a registered source root or current workspace.

filename.description: Optional filename. Unsafe path characters are sanitized; an image extension is added when missing.

max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to download. Default: 10485760. Hard cap: 26214400.
